propositions: GitHub code-scanning alert #88 flags bare substring containment in the upstream-URL assertion, which accepts lookalike hosts (prefix-style notpandoc.org or suffix-style pandoc.org.evil.com)
The old expression uses 'pandoc.org in text or github.com/jgm/pandoc in text' without scheme or host-boundary anchoring, allowing non-actionable NOTICE mentions
Replace substring checks with a scheme+host-anchored regex using negative lookahead for end-of-host boundary: r'https?://(www\.)?pandoc\.org(?![\w.-])|https?://github\.com/jgm/pandoc(?![\w-])'
The anchored regex rejects suffix lookalike (pandoc.org.evil.com) and prefix lookalike (notpandoc.org) while accepting real NOTICE content and valid forms like https://pandoc.org/
Test file module-level regex definition plus single assertion update; version pins and NOTICE content unchanged
